verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's Retention report explicitly measures user engagement over time (mixpanel-docs-3), and properties/cohorts allow segmenting/filtering by behavioral groups (mixpanel-docs-16), with the Query API able to return cohorts and break down events (mixpanel-docs-39, mixpanel-docs-45). This directly matches the story of measuring retention and slicing by behavioral cohorts. Missing for 10: no explicit doc snippet showing retention report UI combined with cohort filter side-by-side, and no independent/hands-on validation of retention-by-cohort accuracy.
